setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: A fresh session with Song mode On, its default. Channel 1 plays its default phrase through the test device and the norns shows the Device page; nothing is playing. You build the song in the next step: a two-note motif (MIDI 60, 62) copied into slots 1, 2, 4 and 5, with slots 3 and 6 left empty.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), tap (2,7), which jumps to 1 step, then tap (8,7) once. The Playback screen reads Global length 2, so every slot plays a two-note motif, 60 and 62.
steps.title: Set the global length to 2

steps.caption: Hold slot 1 at (1,1) and tap slot 2 at (2,1) to copy it, then tap slot 2. Tap Channel (3,8), select channel 1 at (1,1) and tap octave +1 at (11,8). Slot 2 will sound 72 and 74.
steps.title: Copy slot 1 into slot 2 and raise it an octave

steps.caption: Repeat for slot 4, leaving slot 3 empty: copy slot 1 into slot 4 and give it octave +2 at (12,8). Then copy slot 1 into slot 5 and give it octave -1 at (9,8). Slots 3 and 6 stay empty, so there are two groups: slots 1 and 2, and slots 4 and 5.
steps.title: Add slots 4 and 5

steps.caption: Tap slot 1 at (1,1) and press Play (1,8). Slot 1 sounds 60, 62, then slot 2 sounds 72, 74. Slot 3 is empty, so the group ends and playback returns to slot 1: 60, 62, 72, 74, 60, 62, 72, 74. Press Stop.
steps.title: Loop the first group

steps.caption: Tap slot 4 at (4,1) and press Play. Slot 4 sounds 84, 86 and slot 5 sounds 48, 50. Slot 6 is empty, so this second group repeats on its own: 84, 86, 48, 50, 84, 86, 48, 50. Press Stop.
steps.title: A second group

steps.caption: Tap slot 4 at (4,1) and press Play: slot 4 sounds 84, 86. While it plays, press slot 2 at (2,1). The press is queued, not instant. Slot 4 finishes, then slot 2 plays (72, 74) and its group carries on with slot 1 (60, 62) and slot 2 (72, 74). Press Stop; the screen shows where playback ended.
steps.title: Select the next slot while playing

steps.caption: Tap slot 1 and press Play. After the first note, press slot 4 and then slot 5 before slot 1 ends. Slot 1 finishes (60, 62), then the later press wins: slot 5 plays (48, 50), and its group continues with slot 4 (84, 86) and slot 5 again. Press Stop.
steps.title: Two presses before the boundary

steps.caption: Tap K1 to open the norns menu, choose PARAMS > MOSAIC, find Song mode and turn E3 to Off. The row reads Off.
steps.title: Turn Song mode off

steps.caption: Press K2 to leave the menu, select slot 1 at (1,1) and press Play. Slot 1 repeats, 60, 62, 60, 62, and does not advance to slot 2. Slot setup shows Song mode Off. Press Stop.
steps.title: Song mode off holds the slot

steps.caption: With Song mode Off, press Play on slot 1, then tap slot 2 at (2,1) while it plays. The press is still queued: slot 1 finishes (60, 62), then slot 2 repeats (72, 74, 72, 74) and keeps repeating. Song Playback reads Song mode MANUAL and Next HOLD.
steps.title: Manual selection still works

steps.caption: Turn Song mode On again the same way (PARAMS > MOSAIC), select slot 2 and press Play. Progression resumes inside the group: slot 2 (72, 74), slot 1 (60, 62), slot 2, slot 1.
steps.title: Song mode back on
